observations.text: Aerobic Capacity (Low Impact) Block 12 - Week 3
Daily Summary
This session is a low-impact aerobic capacity and consolidation day, designed to support recovery from the week's intensity work while continuing to build the aerobic engine.
When this day sits between two intensity sessions, it should be treated conservatively.

Below 60% recovery: Strongly consider swapping to an Active Recovery Day, or completing Minimum Effective Dose (MED) only.
